decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording one commission and one ticket per primary mint and excluding secondary-market sales.
The source establishes an accounting rule and reports missing random rewards; it does not request a change to FAQ content.
The source does not change the mint price, monetary split, or prize-pool allocation, and the existing per-primary-mint commission allocation remains valid.
One commission and ticket for each coded primary mint is already represented by the reward per successful referral; the source chiefly addresses randomly assigned no-code rewards.
Excluding secondary sales from commissions and tickets does not exclude their royalties from funding the prize pool or change the primary-mint pool contribution.
The commission-and-ticket accounting rule does not change the NFT mint number's use, persistence, or display as a referral code.
The source concerns reward registration after primary mints and does not change which asset must be minted or delivered.
The source does not modify the USDC approval-to-mint flow or its expected completion behavior.
The reward-accounting decision does not alter when mint-success feedback may be displayed.
The source changes ticket issuance accounting, not the Small Block prize amount, winner count, draw trigger, or eligible ticket-holder population.
The source does not change which referral codes are valid or the prohibition on self-referral.
The source does not request revised valid-code or invalid/no-code feedback wording.
